rows.text: You are an Urban Maintenance Specialist in Duomension City, responsible for maintaining the city's visual appeal. Your workload always skyrockets during the Phantasmoon Games.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: That day, a flying saucer streaked across the sky and crashed into the city center. You rushed to the scene to find the building reduced to scattered debris, and a green orch hauling themself from the wreckage.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "Hold on a sec, I can make it up to ya!" The orch waved frantically. "There ain't nothin' I can't figure out. Name your price!"
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe
